equivalence_result_rule: contradicted_in_observed_sample iff at least one included pair has different source assay bands; empty paired domain not_evaluable; otherwise not_contradicted_in_observed_sample, never a clinical validation pass.
limitations: Used-source reconstruction; not an independent holdout.
No gold-standard latent state or assay sensitivity/specificity identified.
DIQ No is a survey response, not complete negative diagnosis history.
No diabetes type, medication history, confirmation, remission, onset or dietary causal effect identified.
GHB instrument change is not linked to individuals in these selected fields; cannot attribute discordance to it.
Pregnancy unknown outside public scope retained; age80 is topcoded.
Overlapping age/sex domains, response/availability partitions and denominators are dependent.
No item-nonresponse correction or full NCHS reliability screening implemented.
observation_interpretation: Paired single-wave assay threshold observations; no diagnosis confirmation, latent clinical state, gold standard or temporal transition.
paired_denominator: Eligible paired-valid assays and literal source DIQ010==2. No response does not establish complete negative lifetime history.
population: U.S. civilian noninstitutionalized adults age20+ with positive NHANES fasting-subsample weights, excluding known pregnancy at ages20-44; incomplete observations retained in eligible-population categories

provenance.chronology: Both current and historical NHANES bytes, codebooks, published outcomes and reconstructed aggregates were inspected/used before this draft. New paired assay-label diagnostics have not been computed by this build. Commit freeze must precede new diagnostic execution; not preregistration or an untouched evaluation set.

nhanes_assay_observation_2021_2023.transformation: Within-person A1c/FPG band classification using unchanged registered cutoffs; current fasting survey design, domain ratios and dependent Taylor covariance; fixed off-diagonal projection. No assay error-rate, latent-state or clinical transition fit.
nhanes_assay_observation_2021_2023.uncertainty: Joint with-replacement first-stage Taylor ratios and fixed projection; complete cross-domain/category/denominator covariance. Scalar logit-t intervals are marginal, not simultaneous; boundary/empty estimates have no fabricated interval.
